## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 401 captures during April 2023. Activity was completed as part of the clinic’s routine service, with image capture undertaken for patients attending the site. The available activity record has been reviewed for completeness and is reported below alongside the image quality and grading results.

## Image quality

There were 22 ungradable image sets, representing an ungradable rate of 5.5 per cent. This result indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment. The ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine quality checks so that any recurring issues with image capture, patient positioning, or equipment use can be identified and addressed.

## Grading

A total of 97 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2 days, providing a timely result for the activity recorded during the month. The grading position should continue to be monitored as part of normal service oversight, particularly alongside the referable result volume and image quality findings.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. No additional operational issues were reported in the information provided for April 2023.
